text: Groups multiple data sources into a single 'collection' that can be searched via one endpoint.
quote: A collection is a group of different data sources that you can search using a single endpoint.

text: A source connection handles authentication and automatically keeps data synced from a connected app or database.
quote: A source connection links a specific app or database to your collection. It handles authentication and automatically syncs data.

text: Offers a direct vector search mode optimized for speed, roughly 0.5 seconds.
quote: Direct vector search. Use when speed is critical (~0.5sec).

text: An AI agent can iteratively search data using multiple strategies, read full documents, and navigate entity hierarchies to build comprehensive results.
quote: An AI agent iteratively searches your data using tool calling. It searches with multiple strategies, reads full documents, navigates entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling), and builds a comprehensive result set.

text: Provides an official MCP server implementing the Model Context Protocol so AI assistants can search synced data.
quote: The Airweave MCP server implements the Model Context Protocol to let AI assistants search your synced data.

text: Ships an official CLI whose primary use is searching any collection from the terminal.
quote: The primary use case — search any collection from your terminal

text: Publishes official skills so agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode etc. can set up integrations and search data automatically.
quote: Airweave publishes official skills so that agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other environments can set up integrations and search your data without you having to explain how every time.

text: Airweave Connect is a hosted, embeddable UI widget letting end users connect apps (Slack, GitHub, Drive, Notion, etc.) directly inside your product.
quote: Airweave Connect is a hosted, embeddable UI widget that lets end users connect their apps (Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, Notion, and more) directly inside your product.

text: Sends real-time webhook notifications for events like sync completion, connection creation, and collection updates instead of requiring polling.
quote: Webhooks are real-time notifications that Airweave sends when things happen in your organization: syncs completing, source connections being created, collections being updated.

text: Authentication providers let you reuse existing authenticated connections from third-party platforms like Composio or Pipedream.
quote: Authentication providers let you reuse existing authenticated connections from third-party platforms such as Composio or Pipedream.

text: Can be self-hosted by cloning the GitHub repo and running a start script, deployable locally on macOS, Linux, or WSL with a local dashboard.
quote: git clone https://github.com/airweave-ai/airweave.git cd airweave ./start.sh

text: Lets you build a custom connector for unsupported tools and either use it locally or contribute it back to the community.
quote: If your favorite tool or API is not yet supported, you can build a connector and either use it locally or contribute it back to the community.

text: Allows supplying existing OAuth tokens directly so users don't need additional authentication interaction.
quote: Airweave therefore allows you to provide existing tokens to Airweave directly, so that... No additional user interaction required.

text: Provides a LlamaIndex tool package (AirweaveToolSpec) giving LlamaIndex agents access to Airweave's search capabilities.
quote: The llama-index-tools-airweave package provides an AirweaveToolSpec that gives your LlamaIndex agents access to Airweave's search capabilities.

text: Available in the Google MCP Store, letting coding agents instantly search all synced apps and databases with zero extra setup.
quote: enabling your coding agents to instantly search across all your synced apps and databases with zero additional setup required

text: Pipedream integration provides actions to search synced data, manage collections, and trigger syncs from any workflow or automation.
quote: The Airweave integration provides a set of actions that enable you to search your synced data to retrieve relevant context, manage your collections, and trigger syncs from any Pipedream workflow

text: Connects to apps, databases, and documents, turning them into a single searchable knowledge base.
quote: Airweave connects to your apps, databases, and documents, then turns them into knowledge you can search.

text: Official Python SDK lets you programmatically create a source connection and sync data into a collection.
quote:
# Connect to a source and sync data into your collection
client.source_connections.create(

text: Provides a Vercel AI SDK package with an airweaveSearch tool for direct integration into AI SDK apps.
quote: The @airweave/vercel-ai-sdk package provides an airweaveSearch tool that integrates seamlessly with the Vercel AI SDK.

text: Offers a no-code native block to search synced data collections from any workflow builder.
quote: The native Airweave block lets you search your synced data collections from any workflow, no code required.

text: Airtable connector syncs bases, tables, records, comments, and attachments.
quote: Airtable source connector — syncs bases, tables, records, comments, attachments.

text: GitHub connector syncs workspaces, repositories, directories, and code files with configurable branch/file-type filtering.
quote: It supports syncing workspaces, repositories, directories, and code files with configurable filtering options for branches and file types.
